name: Textarea
summary: Enter multi-line free text — descriptions, messages, notes — with autosize and char count, rendered through the shared Textarea.
lead: Textarea rides on Ant's Input.TextArea for autosize, char-count and form integration: antd v6 (React) and ant-design-vue v4 (Vue), both themed once by the shared textareaTheme. Two implementations, one DS V3 look. This is the composite half of the hybrid.

props.name: onChange
props.desc: Fires on each change; read e.target.value

whenToUse.when: multi-line free text — a description, a message, notes
short single-line text — a name, a title, a search term
one value from a known set — don't make the user type it

opinion.note: Prefer autoSize with a minRows/maxRows band so the field grows with content but never dominates the layout. Pair maxLength with showCount so the limit is visible, not a surprise on submit.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: Composite has no framework-free element, so its paste-and-run form is a CDN-React page — React + antd load from a CDN and mount on open, consuming the same shared textareaTheme. No build step.

codeNote: React and Vue are two real vendor libraries at two Ant generations — they can't share a primitive. They converge via the same token/theme (textareaTheme); residual drift is caught by visual regression.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Composite shown as a CDN-React page mounted at #react-root; the measure reads the real antd v6 TextArea bound to textareaTheme.
